notes.title: Final FINAL Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I lied. >-< I actually have another update, but after this I SWEAR I am done, and will soon be moving onto Object Ward's other project, The Cut. Stay tuned! For now, here is the changelog:

MAJOR:
-Remade the Object Ward opening video in Ren'py! It was originally created using Adobe Primere which I had as a college student, but lost access to. Screw adobe...

Fixed Mrs. Clarice's (Diamond) name

notes.title: Lil Update & Upcoming Soundtrack!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I have two important notices- an lil' update & the upcoming soundtrack page!
First, for the update:

Redesigned Dorothy's hair. The original one was a tad boring, but this one is far cuter and compliments her personality well.
The Inspector's human sprite now appears in the Friendship route.
Further tweaks to human sprites, ATL, and grammatical errors. If you spy any more problems, please let me know!


Now, for the soundtrack, which will be purchasable. It contains 39 rocking tunes composed by Red Robotrix: 37 that were originally in Object Ward, and 2 from the April Fools game The Hole of Love. Yes, that game will eventually be ported to Steam's April Fools Collection (Needs some ironing out).

But anyhoo, wishlist the official Object Ward soundtrack here! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3166170/Object_Ward_Soundtrack/

notes.title: Whoops... T-Minus 1 extra month until release!
notes.notes:
I bring some unfortunate news: I must delay Object Ward due to my... tenacious work ethic which has aggravated a recent hand injury. The new release date is JULY 12th!

If it were not for this injury and the required physical therapy, this game would have been released on time.


 Art is 100%
 Music is 100%
 3/7 routes programmed
 Story is 99% done aside from minor edits during programming

THE WAIT IS WORTH IT, AND IT WILL NOT BE MUCH LONGER!!! :)

notes.title: T-Minus 1 Month Until Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I have some exciting news... Object Ward will be released on May 31st! This game has been in development for nearly six years, and will finally be experienced by players. Despite Object Ward's strangeness, it's a story of love, friendship, and personal growth. I hope you all will enjoy.[previewyoutube=J4uwlV7j3hU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

There will be
-7 Awesome routes with 4 men & 2 women to romance
-150k+ words
-21 endings
-Over 40 unique CGs
-Option to turn off gay/straight/both adult scenes, + free adult patch

Wishlist the game if you haven't already. Share and spread the news!
